verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no product feature for creating automations that run on their own in the background, such as scheduled, recurring or triggered agent tasks. llmster, the headless daemon, and the REST API only serve models for the user's own apps and scripts. They are developer building blocks, not an automation capability. Bionic and the 'advanced agentic tasks' claims describe interactive agent sessions, not autonomous background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
